summary.text: Kellan is a young half-fae man from Eldraine, son of the planeswalker Oko, who travels across planes searching for his father and learns to use his fae magic.

bio.text: At sixteen, Kellan was given a quest by the fae lord Talion to defeat the three witch sisters and end the Wicked Slumber, which he accepted hoping to learn the truth about his father.
He killed Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron, and with Ruby he won Hylda's surrender, and he later learned from his mother that his father was the planeswalker Oko.
Searching for Oko through the Omenpaths, he reached Ixalan, where Amalia saved him, and the two sided with the Oltecs against Aclazotz before leaving through an Omenpath together.
On Ravnica he joined the Agency, earned honors for stopping the god Anzrag, and with Kaya helped catch Etrata and face Oba in the Karlov Manor case, discovering in the fight that he could fly.
On Thunder Junction he found Oko, who took him along as an asset, then abandoned him on the hijacked train and again at Tarnation.

Kellan fully accepted his fae heritage and mind-controlled Akul into the collapsing vault so that Annie could escape, after which Oko's gang disbanded and Kellan invited Amalia to explore Thunder Junction.
He later began dreaming of Lorwyn, where Oona appeared to him and said she awaited him.

status.text: Kellan is alive and was last seen in Lorwyn Eclipsed in 2026, waking from dreams to find flowers blooming from his tongue, while Oko chose to stay absent from his life.
